## Chimera v1.1.23 - settings, search, visible feedback

A shell release. The farm loops, the offsets table and the ESP are the same code as 1.1.22.

### Settings tab

New rail entry under the data group. The Updates card shows the installed version, the latest published version and the channel state, with Check and Install on the same row. Install runs the updater the app already used at startup: the installer closes this window, replaces the files and brings it back.

Release notes now render as notes - headings, paragraphs, inline code - in their own scroll area. They used to arrive as one collapsed paragraph with the markdown markers still in it.

### Search reaches the toggles

The palette indexes every toggle as well as every screen. `Fishing > Auto cast` resolves to the row itself: Enter opens Fishing, scrolls to the row and pulses it. Multi-word queries match in any order, and row descriptions are searchable.

### Toasts were never drawn

`toast()` queued a message in the store and no component rendered the queue, so Check, Install, Re-attach and the engine switch all reported into nothing. One stack now sits above the status bar with the tone on its left edge.

### Checks

`tsc --noEmit` clean, `vite build` clean, core and shell built from the same tree. Window unchanged at 760 x 480.
